```{r Libraries}
packages <- c("Seurat", "ggplot2","bmrm","tidysdm")
invisible(lapply(packages, library, character.only = TRUE))
rm(list=ls())
```

```{r Model functions}

signal_smooth <- function(logcounts,pseudotime,at,sd) {
  W <- outer(at,pseudotime,FUN="-") |>
    dnorm(sd=sd)
  W <- W/rowSums(W)
  S <- tcrossprod(logcounts,W) |> as.matrix()
  S
}
```


```{r Dataset Loadings and Directory Creation }
dir.create(".../Ordinal_waves")
se <- readRDS(".../ORM_Pseudotime/obj_predicted.RDS")
y0 <- readRDS(".../ORM_Pseudotime/Model_pseudotime_ngenes_cells_subset.RDS")
```
 
```{r, generate expression matrices and pseudotime}
expr_matrix <- GetAssayData(se, slot = "data")

expr_df <- as.data.frame(t(as.matrix(expr_matrix)))
expr_df$pseudotime_normalized <- se@meta.data$pseudotime_normalized
expr_df$condition <- se@meta.data$condition

# Define pseudotime grid
pseudo_grid <- seq(0, 1, length.out = 200)

# Split expr_df by condition
expr_cave    <- expr_df[expr_df$condition == "cave", ]
expr_surface <- expr_df[expr_df$condition == "surface", ]

model_genes <- names(attr(y0,"w.50"))
```


```{r,model genes' waves}
# Run the smoother for pseudotime genes at once (genes x pseudotime matrix)

smooth_pseudotime_surface <- signal_smooth(
  logcounts  = t(as.matrix(expr_surface[,model_genes])),
  pseudotime = expr_surface$pseudotime_normalized,
  at         = pseudo_grid,
  sd         = 0.075
)

smooth_pseudotime_cave <- signal_smooth(
  logcounts  = t(as.matrix(expr_cave[,model_genes])),
  pseudotime = expr_cave$pseudotime_normalized,
  at         = pseudo_grid,
  sd         = 0.075  # tune this — equivalent to span in LOESS
)

# smooth_cave and smooth_surface are genes x pseudotime matrices
rownames(smooth_pseudotime_surface)    <- names(attr(y0,"w.50"))
rownames(smooth_pseudotime_cave) <- names(attr(y0,"w.50"))

saveRDS(smooth_pseudotime_surface,".../Ordinal_waves/SF_pseudotime_waves.RDS")
saveRDS(smooth_pseudotime_cave,".../Ordinal_waves/CF_pseudotime_waves.RDS")
```


```{r}
# Step 1: Cluster the genes
hclust_result <- hclust(dist(smooth_pseudotime_surface))

# Step 2: Cut into clusters (adjust k based on your data)
gene_clusters <- cutree(hclust_result, k = 4)  # Adjust k as needed

# Step 3: Calculate mean peak position for each cluster
cluster_peak_order <- data.frame(
  cluster = unique(gene_clusters)
) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    genes_in_cluster = list(names(gene_clusters)[gene_clusters == cluster]),
    mean_peak_bin = mean(apply(smooth_pseudotime_surface[genes_in_cluster, ], 1, which.max))
  ) %>%
  arrange(mean_peak_bin)

# Step 4: Reorder gene clusters and create annotation
gene_order_by_peak <- unlist(lapply(cluster_peak_order$cluster, function(cl) {
  genes_in_cl <- names(gene_clusters)[gene_clusters == cl]
  # Within each cluster, order by peak position
  peak_positions <- apply(smooth_pseudotime_surface[genes_in_cl, ], 1, which.max)
  genes_in_cl[order(peak_positions)]
}))

# Create row annotation for clusters
row_annotation <- data.frame(
  Cluster = factor(gene_clusters[gene_order_by_peak])
)
rownames(row_annotation) <- gene_order_by_peak

# Step 5: Plot with gaps between clusters
cluster_sizes <- table(gene_clusters[gene_order_by_peak])
gap_positions <- cumsum(cluster_sizes)[-length(cluster_sizes)]

library(pheatmap)
p1 <- pheatmap(smooth_pseudotime_surface[gene_order_by_peak, ],
               cluster_rows = FALSE,
               cluster_cols = FALSE,
               show_rownames = TRUE,
               color = colorRampPalette(c("white", "darkblue"))(100),
               main = "Gene expression waves across pseudotime SF",
               annotation_row = row_annotation)

p2 <- pheatmap(smooth_pseudotime_cave[gene_order_by_peak, ],
               cluster_rows = FALSE,
               cluster_cols = FALSE,
               show_rownames = TRUE,
               color = colorRampPalette(c("white", "firebrick"))(100),
               main = "Gene expression waves across pseudotime CF",
               annotation_row = row_annotation)

ggsave(".../Ordinal_waves/pseudotime_genes_SF_waves.pdf", p1, width = 8, height = 10)
ggsave(".../Ordinal_waves/pseudotime_genes_CF_waves.pdf", p2, width = 8, height = 10)
```


```{r, gene selection}
# Filter genes that are expressed at least in a 10% of cells of 1 of the 2 conditions
counts <- GetAssayData(se, layer = "data")

cave_cells    <- se$condition == "cave"
surface_cells <- se$condition == "surface"

frac_cave    <- rowSums(counts[, cave_cells] > 0) / sum(cave_cells)
frac_surface <- rowSums(counts[, surface_cells] > 0) / sum(surface_cells)

genes_keep <- rownames(counts)[frac_cave >= 0.10 | frac_surface >= 0.10]
table(genes_keep%in%rownames(se))
```

```{r, calculate all gene waves}
# Run the smoother for all genes at once (genes x pseudotime matrix)
smooth_cave <- signal_smooth(
  logcounts  = t(as.matrix(expr_cave[, genes_keep])),
  pseudotime = expr_cave$pseudotime_normalized,
  at         = pseudo_grid,
  sd         = 0.075  # tune this — equivalent to span in LOESS
)

smooth_surface <- signal_smooth(
  logcounts  = t(as.matrix(expr_surface[, genes_keep])),
  pseudotime = expr_surface$pseudotime_normalized,
  at         = pseudo_grid,
  sd         = 0.075
)
```

```{r, calculate all gene waves}
# Step 1: variability filter
surface_range <- apply(smooth_surface, 1, \(x) diff(range(x)))
cave_range    <- apply(smooth_cave,    1, \(x) diff(range(x)))

pass_variability <- surface_range > 0.5 | cave_range > 0.5
removed_variability <- rownames(smooth_surface)[!pass_variability]
cat("genes removed by low variability:", length(removed_variability), "\n")

smooth_surface_filtered <- smooth_surface[pass_variability, ]
smooth_cave_filtered    <- smooth_cave[pass_variability, ]

# Step 2: DEG filter on remaining genes
surface_range  <- apply(smooth_surface_filtered, 1, \(x) diff(range(x)))
mean_diff_norm <- abs(rowMeans(smooth_cave_filtered) - rowMeans(smooth_surface_filtered)) / surface_range

threshold_mean_diff_norm <- quantile(mean_diff_norm, 0.90)
pass_deg     <- mean_diff_norm <= threshold_mean_diff_norm
removed_deg  <- names(mean_diff_norm)[!pass_deg]
cat("genes removed by DEG filter:", length(removed_deg), "\n")

smooth_surface_filtered_2 <- smooth_surface_filtered[pass_deg, ]
smooth_cave_filtered_2    <- smooth_cave_filtered[pass_deg, ]

cat("genes kept:", nrow(smooth_surface_filtered_2), "\n")
cat("90th percentile threshold:", round(threshold_mean_diff_norm, 3), "\n")
```


```{r, classify wave types}
# Combine matrices, tagging by morph
combined <- rbind(
  smooth_surface_filtered_2 |> as_tibble(rownames = "symbol") |> mutate(morph = "surface"),
  smooth_cave_filtered_2    |> as_tibble(rownames = "symbol") |> mutate(morph = "cave")
)

# Run UMAP on the expression columns only
M_combined <- combined |> select(starts_with("V")) |> as.matrix()
umap_coords <- uwot::umap(M_combined, metric = "correlation")

# Add UMAP coordinates back
combined <- combined |>
  mutate(UMAP1 = umap_coords[, 1],
         UMAP2 = umap_coords[, 2])

ggplot(combined,aes(UMAP1,UMAP2,col=morph))+
  geom_point(stroke=NA,size=1.5)+
  coord_equal()+
  theme_minimal()

length(unique(combined$symbol))

combined$cluster <- bluster::clusterRows(
  umap_coords,
  bluster::NNGraphParam(k = 40, cluster.fun = "louvain", cluster.args = list(resolution = 2))
)

table(combined$cluster)

cluster_centers <- combined |>
  group_by(cluster) |>
  summarise(UMAP1 = mean(UMAP1), UMAP2 = mean(UMAP2))

ggplot(combined, aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, col = cluster)) +
  geom_point(stroke = NA, size = 1.5) +
  geom_label(data = cluster_centers, aes(label = cluster),
             color = "black", size = 3, alpha = 0.7) +
  coord_equal() +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(combined, aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, col = cluster)) +
  geom_point(stroke = NA, size = 1.5) +
  geom_point(data = \(x) filter(x, symbol == "cadm3"),
             color = "black", size = 3, stroke = 1, shape = 21,
             aes(fill = cluster)) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(data = \(x) filter(x, symbol == "cadm3"),
                            aes(label = symbol),
                            color = "black", size = 3, box.padding = 0.5) +
  geom_label(data = cluster_centers, aes(label = cluster),
             color = "black", size = 3, alpha = 0.7) +
  coord_equal() +
  theme_minimal()

combined |>
  group_by(cluster) |>
  summarise(across(starts_with("V"), mean)) |>
  pivot_longer(starts_with("V"), names_to = "t", values_to = "expr") |>
  mutate(t = as.integer(str_remove(t, "V"))) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = t, y = expr, color = cluster)) +
  geom_line() +
  ylim(c(0,2))+
  facet_wrap(~cluster) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(x = "Pseudotime", y = "Mean expression")
```

```{r, classify wave types}
table(combined$wave_type)

library(patchwork)

wave_conservation <- combined |>

  ggplot(aes(axis1 = wave_type_surface, axis2 = wave_type_cave, y = n)) +

  scale_x_discrete(limits = c("Surface", "Cave"), expand = c(0.1, 0.1)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(activated = "#E07B54", repressed = "#5B8DB8", transient = "#6DBF82")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(y = "Number of genes", fill = "Wave type") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

p_pie <- ggplot(wave_conservation, aes(x = "", y = n, fill = conserved)) +
  geom_col(width = 1, position = "fill") +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  facet_wrap(~wave_type_surface) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(conserved = "#B4B2A9", divergent = "#444441")) +
  theme_void() +
  labs(fill = NULL) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(n / ave(n, wave_type_surface, FUN = sum) * 100, 1), "%")),
            position = position_fill(vjust = 0.5), color = "white", size = 3.5) +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 9))

p_sankey + p_pie + plot_layout(widths = c(3, 1))

ggsave(".../Ordinal_waves/sankey_plot.pdf", width = 12, height = 8)

saveRDS(combined,".../Ordinal_waves/waves_se_astyanax.RDS")
```

```{r, HH function}
compute_halfheight_combined <- function(combined, window_frac = 0.5, sustain_threshold = 0.4, cor_threshold = 0.75) {
  
  wave_cols <- grep("^V", colnames(combined), value = TRUE)
  n <- length(wave_cols)
  window_size <- round(n * window_frac)
  
  genes <- unique(combined$symbol)
  
  t(sapply(genes, function(g) {
    tryCatch({
      
    s_cave    <- pmax(as.numeric(combined[combined$symbol == g & combined$morph == "cave",    wave_cols]), 0)
    s_surface <- pmax(as.numeric(combined[combined$symbol == g & combined$morph == "surface", wave_cols]), 0)
    
    variations <- sapply(1:(n - window_size), function(i) {
      diff(range(s_surface[i:(i + window_size)]))
    })
    
    best_start <- which.max(variations)
    best_end   <- best_start + window_size
    window_idx <- best_start:best_end
    
    surface_window     <- s_surface[window_idx]
    win_len            <- length(surface_window)
    peak_idx_surface   <- which.max(surface_window)
    trough_idx_surface <- which.min(surface_window)
    is_biphasic_surface <- (peak_idx_surface  > 1 & peak_idx_surface  < win_len) |
                           (trough_idx_surface > 1 & trough_idx_surface < win_len)
    
    peak_idx_cave   <- which.max(s_cave[window_idx])
    trough_idx_cave <- which.min(s_cave[window_idx])
    is_biphasic_cave <- (peak_idx_cave  > 1 & peak_idx_cave  < win_len) |
                        (trough_idx_cave > 1 & trough_idx_cave < win_len)
    
    if (is_biphasic_surface) {
      pos_var <- max(surface_window) - surface_window[1]
      neg_var <- surface_window[1] - min(surface_window)
      if (pos_var >= neg_var) {
        slope_direction    <- "ascending"
        anchor_idx_surface <- peak_idx_surface
      } else {
        slope_direction    <- "descending"
        anchor_idx_surface <- trough_idx_surface
      }
    } else {
      net_var <- surface_window[win_len] - surface_window[1]
      if (net_var >= 0) {
        slope_direction    <- "ascending"
        anchor_idx_surface <- peak_idx_surface
      } else {
        slope_direction    <- "descending"
        anchor_idx_surface <- trough_idx_surface
      }
    }
    
    if (slope_direction == "ascending") {
      surface_min_w <- min(surface_window[1:anchor_idx_surface])
      surface_max_w <- surface_window[anchor_idx_surface]
    } else {
      surface_max_w <- max(surface_window[1:anchor_idx_surface])
      surface_min_w <- surface_window[anchor_idx_surface]
    }
    amplitude   <- surface_max_w - surface_min_w
    half_height <- surface_min_w + amplitude / 2
    
    wave_cor <- cor(s_cave, s_surface)
    
    check_sustain <- function(s, crossing_idx) {
      post <- s[crossing_idx:n]
      if (slope_direction == "ascending") {
        sum(post >= half_height) / length(post) >= sustain_threshold
      } else {
        sum(post <= half_height) / length(post) >= sustain_threshold
      }
    }
    
    get_crossing <- function(s, other_crossing = NULL) {
      s_window <- s[window_idx]
      
      anchor <- if (slope_direction == "ascending") which.min(s_window) else which.max(s_window)
      s_window_anchored <- s_window[anchor:win_len]
      
      if (slope_direction == "descending") {
        idx_anchored <- which(s_window_anchored[-length(s_window_anchored)] > half_height & 
                              s_window_anchored[-1] <= half_height)[1]
      } else {
        idx_anchored <- which(s_window_anchored[-length(s_window_anchored)] < half_height & 
                              s_window_anchored[-1] >= half_height)[1]
      }
      
      idx <- if (!is.na(idx_anchored)) idx_anchored + anchor - 1 else NA
      
      if (is.na(idx)) {
        if (slope_direction == "ascending") {
          all_crossings <- which(s[-n] < half_height & s[-1] >= half_height)
        } else {
          all_crossings <- which(s[-n] > half_height & s[-1] <= half_height)
        }
        if (length(all_crossings) == 0) {
          list(value = 0, method = "HH not reached")
        } else {
          if (!is.null(other_crossing) && !is.na(other_crossing) && other_crossing > 0) {
            ref     <- which.min(abs(pseudo_grid - other_crossing))
            closest <- all_crossings[which.min(abs(all_crossings - ref))]
          } else {
            ref     <- ifelse(all_crossings[1] < window_idx[1],
                              window_idx[1],
                              window_idx[length(window_idx)])
            closest <- all_crossings[which.min(abs(all_crossings - ref))]
          }
          if (!check_sustain(s, closest)) {
            list(value = 0, method = "HH not reached")
          } else {
            list(value = pseudo_grid[closest], method = "hh_full_range")
          }
        }
      } else {
        actual_idx <- window_idx[idx]
        if (!check_sustain(s, actual_idx)) {
          list(value = 0, method = "HH not reached")
        } else {
          list(value = pseudo_grid[actual_idx], method = "hh")
        }
      }
    }
    
    surface_cross <- get_crossing(s_surface)
    
    cave_can_cross <- max(s_cave) >= half_height & min(s_cave) <= half_height
    
    if (!cave_can_cross) {
      cave_cross <- list(value = 0, method = "HH not reached")
      
    } else if (wave_cor >= cor_threshold) {
      cave_cross <- get_crossing(s_cave, other_crossing = surface_cross$value)
      if (slope_direction == "ascending" && s_cave[window_idx[1]] >= half_height) {
        cave_cross <- list(value = 0, method = "HH not reached")
      } else if (slope_direction == "descending" && s_cave[window_idx[1]] <= half_height) {
        cave_cross <- list(value = 0, method = "HH not reached")
      }
      
    } else {
      if (slope_direction == "ascending") {
        all_crossings <- which(s_cave[-n] < half_height & s_cave[-1] >= half_height)
      } else {
        all_crossings <- which(s_cave[-n] > half_height & s_cave[-1] <= half_height)
      }
      if (length(all_crossings) == 0) {
        cave_cross <- list(value = 0, method = "HH not reached")
      } else {
        ref     <- which.min(abs(pseudo_grid - surface_cross$value))
        closest <- all_crossings[which.min(abs(all_crossings - ref))]
        if (!check_sustain(s_cave, closest)) {
          cave_cross <- list(value = 0, method = "HH not reached")
        } else {
          cave_cross <- list(value = pseudo_grid[closest], method = "hh_full_range")
        }
      }
    }
    
    c(
      global_max                     = max(c(s_cave[window_idx], s_surface[window_idx]), na.rm = TRUE),
      global_min                     = min(c(s_cave[window_idx], s_surface[window_idx]), na.rm = TRUE),
      amplitude                      = amplitude,
      cave_max                       = max(s_cave),
      surface_max                    = max(s_surface),
      half_height                    = half_height,
      wave_cor                       = wave_cor,
      window_start                   = pseudo_grid[best_start],
      window_end                     = pseudo_grid[best_end],
      window_start_idx               = best_start,
      window_end_idx                 = best_end,
      cave_pseudotime_half_height    = cave_cross$value,
      surface_pseudotime_half_height = surface_cross$value,
      cave_method                    = cave_cross$method,
      surface_method                 = surface_cross$method,
      biphasic_cave                  = as.integer(is_biphasic_cave),
      biphasic_surface               = as.integer(is_biphasic_surface),
      biphasic_type                  = case_when(
        is_biphasic_cave & is_biphasic_surface ~ "both",
        is_biphasic_cave                       ~ "cave only",
        is_biphasic_surface                    ~ "surface only",
        TRUE                                   ~ "none"
      )
    )
    
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat("ERROR in gene:", g, "\n")
      cat("Message:", e$message, "\n")
      rep(NA, 19)
    })
  }))
}
```

```{r, compute HH analysis for combined waves}
compute_halfheight_combined <- function(combined, window_frac = 0.5, sustain_threshold = 0.4, cor_threshold = 0.75) {
  
  wave_cols <- grep("^V", colnames(combined), value = TRUE)
  n <- length(wave_cols)
  window_size <- round(n * window_frac)

    tryCatch({
      
    s_cave    <- pmax(as.numeric(combined[combined$symbol == g & combined$morph == "cave",    wave_cols]), 0)
    s_surface <- pmax(as.numeric(combined[combined$symbol == g & combined$morph == "surface", wave_cols]), 0)
    
    variations <- sapply(1:(n - window_size), function(i) {
      diff(range(s_surface[i:(i + window_size)]))
    })
    
    best_start <- which.max(variations)
    best_end   <- best_start + window_size
    window_idx <- best_start:best_end
    
    surface_window     <- s_surface[window_idx]
    win_len            <- length(surface_window)
    peak_idx_surface   <- which.max(surface_window)
    trough_idx_surface <- which.min(surface_window)
    is_biphasic_surface <- (peak_idx_surface  > 1 & peak_idx_surface  < win_len) |
                           (trough_idx_surface > 1 & trough_idx_surface < win_len)
    
    peak_idx_cave   <- which.max(s_cave[window_idx])
    trough_idx_cave <- which.min(s_cave[window_idx])
    is_biphasic_cave <- (peak_idx_cave  > 1 & peak_idx_cave  < win_len) |
                        (trough_idx_cave > 1 & trough_idx_cave < win_len)
    
    if (is_biphasic_surface) {
      pos_var <- max(surface_window) - surface_window[1]
      neg_var <- surface_window[1] - min(surface_window)
      if (pos_var >= neg_var) {
        slope_direction    <- "ascending"
        anchor_idx_surface <- peak_idx_surface
      } else {
        slope_direction    <- "descending"
        anchor_idx_surface <- trough_idx_surface
      }
    } else {
      net_var <- surface_window[win_len] - surface_window[1]
      if (net_var >= 0) {
        slope_direction    <- "ascending"
        anchor_idx_surface <- peak_idx_surface
      } else {
        slope_direction    <- "descending"
        anchor_idx_surface <- trough_idx_surface
      }
    }
    
    if (slope_direction == "ascending") {
      surface_min_w <- min(surface_window[1:anchor_idx_surface])
      surface_max_w <- surface_window[anchor_idx_surface]
    } else {
      surface_max_w <- max(surface_window[1:anchor_idx_surface])
      surface_min_w <- surface_window[anchor_idx_surface]
    }
    amplitude   <- surface_max_w - surface_min_w
    half_height <- surface_min_w + amplitude / 2
    
    wave_cor <- cor(s_cave, s_surface)
    
    check_sustain <- function(s, crossing_idx) {
      post <- s[crossing_idx:n]
      if (slope_direction == "ascending") {
        sum(post >= half_height) / length(post) >= sustain_threshold
      } else {
        sum(post <= half_height) / length(post) >= sustain_threshold
      }
    }
    
    get_crossing <- function(s, other_crossing = NULL) {
      s_window <- s[window_idx]
      
      anchor <- if (slope_direction == "ascending") which.min(s_window) else which.max(s_window)
      s_window_anchored <- s_window[anchor:win_len]
      
      if (slope_direction == "descending") {
        idx_anchored <- which(s_window_anchored[-length(s_window_anchored)] > half_height & 
                              s_window_anchored[-1] <= half_height)[1]
      } else {
        idx_anchored <- which(s_window_anchored[-length(s_window_anchored)] < half_height & 
                              s_window_anchored[-1] >= half_height)[1]
      }
      
      idx <- if (!is.na(idx_anchored)) idx_anchored + anchor - 1 else NA
      
      if (is.na(idx)) {
        if (slope_direction == "ascending") {
          all_crossings <- which(s[-n] < half_height & s[-1] >= half_height)
        } else {
          all_crossings <- which(s[-n] > half_height & s[-1] <= half_height)
        }
        if (length(all_crossings) == 0) {
          list(value = 0, method = "HH not reached")
        } else {
          if (!is.null(other_crossing) && !is.na(other_crossing) && other_crossing > 0) {
            ref     <- which.min(abs(pseudo_grid - other_crossing))
            closest <- all_crossings[which.min(abs(all_crossings - ref))]
          } else {
            ref     <- ifelse(all_crossings[1] < window_idx[1],
                              window_idx[1],
                              window_idx[length(window_idx)])
            closest <- all_crossings[which.min(abs(all_crossings - ref))]
          }
          if (!check_sustain(s, closest)) {
            list(value = 0, method = "HH not reached")
          } else {
            list(value = pseudo_grid[closest], method = "hh_full_range")
          }
        }
      } else {
        actual_idx <- window_idx[idx]
        if (!check_sustain(s, actual_idx)) {
          list(value = 0, method = "HH not reached")
        } else {
          list(value = pseudo_grid[actual_idx], method = "hh")
        }
      }
    }
    
    surface_cross <- get_crossing(s_surface)
    
    cave_can_cross <- max(s_cave) >= half_height & min(s_cave) <= half_height
    
    if (!cave_can_cross) {
      cave_cross <- list(value = 0, method = "HH not reached")
      
    } else if (wave_cor >= cor_threshold) {
      cave_cross <- get_crossing(s_cave, other_crossing = surface_cross$value)
      if (slope_direction == "ascending" && s_cave[window_idx[1]] >= half_height) {
        cave_cross <- list(value = 0, method = "HH not reached")
      } else if (slope_direction == "descending" && s_cave[window_idx[1]] <= half_height) {
        cave_cross <- list(value = 0, method = "HH not reached")
      }
      
    } else {
      if (slope_direction == "ascending") {
        all_crossings <- which(s_cave[-n] < half_height & s_cave[-1] >= half_height)
      } else {
        all_crossings <- which(s_cave[-n] > half_height & s_cave[-1] <= half_height)
      }
      if (length(all_crossings) == 0) {
        cave_cross <- list(value = 0, method = "HH not reached")
      } else {
        ref     <- which.min(abs(pseudo_grid - surface_cross$value))
        closest <- all_crossings[which.min(abs(all_crossings - ref))]
        if (!check_sustain(s_cave, closest)) {
          cave_cross <- list(value = 0, method = "HH not reached")
        } else {
          cave_cross <- list(value = pseudo_grid[closest], method = "hh_full_range")
        }
      }
    }
    
    c(
      global_max                     = max(c(s_cave[window_idx], s_surface[window_idx]), na.rm = TRUE),
      global_min                     = min(c(s_cave[window_idx], s_surface[window_idx]), na.rm = TRUE),
      amplitude                      = amplitude,
      cave_max                       = max(s_cave),
      surface_max                    = max(s_surface),
      half_height                    = half_height,
      wave_cor                       = wave_cor,
      window_start                   = pseudo_grid[best_start],
      window_end                     = pseudo_grid[best_end],
      window_start_idx               = best_start,
      window_end_idx                 = best_end,
      cave_pseudotime_half_height    = cave_cross$value,
      surface_pseudotime_half_height = surface_cross$value,
      cave_method                    = cave_cross$method,
      surface_method                 = surface_cross$method,
      biphasic_cave                  = as.integer(is_biphasic_cave),
      biphasic_surface               = as.integer(is_biphasic_surface),
      biphasic_type                  = case_when(
        is_biphasic_cave & is_biphasic_surface ~ "both",
        is_biphasic_cave                       ~ "cave only",
        is_biphasic_surface                    ~ "surface only",
        TRUE                                   ~ "none"
      )
    )
    
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat("ERROR in gene:", g, "\n")
      cat("Message:", e$message, "\n")
      rep(NA, 19)
    })
  }))
}

# run HH
hh <- compute_halfheight_combined(combined, window_frac = 0.5, sustain_threshold = 0.4, cor_threshold = 0.75)

# build results_df with all filters applied → ready to use directly
results_df <- as.data.frame(hh) |>
  rownames_to_column("gene") |>
  mutate(across(-c(gene, cave_method, surface_method, biphasic_type), as.numeric)) |>
  left_join(
    combined |>
      select(symbol, morph, wave_type) |>
      pivot_wider(names_from = morph, values_from = wave_type, values_fn = \(x) x[1]) |>
      mutate(wave_transition = paste0(surface, "_to_", cave)) |>
      select(symbol, wave_transition),
    by = c("gene" = "symbol")
  ) |>
  mutate(
    hh_not_reached  = cave_method == "HH not reached" | surface_method == "HH not reached",
    far_from_window = cave_method == "hh_full_range" &
                      (cave_pseudotime_half_height > window_end + 0.1 |
                       cave_pseudotime_half_height < window_start - 0.1),
    delta           = case_when(
      hh_not_reached                                                              ~ NA_real_,
      wave_cor < 0.5                                                              ~ NA_real_,
      wave_transition %in% c("activated_to_repressed", "repressed_to_activated") ~ NA_real_,
      far_from_window                                                             ~ NA_real_,
      TRUE                                                                        ~ surface_pseudotime_half_height - cave_pseudotime_half_height
    )
  )

results_df_valid <- results_df |> filter(!is.na(delta))

n_early <- sum(results_df_valid$delta < -0.05)
n_late  <- sum(results_df_valid$delta >  0.05)
n_total <- nrow(results_df_valid)

ggplot(results_df_valid, aes(x = delta)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50, fill = "#1D9E75", color = NA) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0,     linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = -0.05, linetype = "dotted", color = "gray60") +
  geom_vline(xintercept =  0.05, linetype = "dotted", color = "gray60") +
  annotate("text", x = min(results_df_valid$delta) + 0.01, y = Inf,
           label = paste0("cave early\n", round(n_early / n_total * 100, 1), "%"),
           hjust = 0, vjust = 1.5, size = 3.5, color = "gray30") +
  annotate("text", x = max(results_df_valid$delta) - 0.01, y = Inf,
           label = paste0("cave late\n", round(n_late / n_total * 100, 1), "%"),
           hjust = 1, vjust = 1.5, size = 3.5, color = "gray30") +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(x = "Δ HH (surface - cave pseudotime)", y = "Number of genes")

ggsave(".../Ordinal_waves/bar_plot_delta_HH.pdf", width = 8, height = 5, device = cairo_pdf)

ggplot(results_df_valid, aes(x = cave_pseudotime_half_height, 
                        y = surface_pseudotime_half_height)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  geom_density_2d(color = "steelblue", alpha = 0.6, linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_point(aes(color = global_max), alpha = 0.5, size = 1.5) +
  scale_color_gradientn(colors = c("gray80", "orange", "red4"), name = "max expression") +
  geom_text_repel(data = results_df_valid[results_df_valid$gene == "fabp7a", ],
                  aes(label = gene), color = "black", size = 3.5) +
  xlim(0, 1) + ylim(0, 1) +
  labs(
    x = "pseudotime at half-height (cave)",
    y = "pseudotime at half-height (surface)",
    title = "Half-height pseudotime shift between conditions"
  ) +
  theme_classic()

ggsave(".../Ordinal_waves/HH_shift.pdf", width = 8, height = 8)

```

```{r, plot gene waves with the HH calculation}

plot_gene_wave <- function(gene) {
  df <- data.frame(
    pseudotime = rep(pseudo_grid, 2),
    expr       = c(smooth_cave[gene, ], smooth_surface[gene, ]),
    condition  = rep(c("cave", "surface"), each = length(pseudo_grid))
  )
  
  gene_row <- results_df[results_df$gene == gene, ]
  
  cave_linetype    <- ifelse(gene_row$cave_method    == "hh_full_range", "dashed", "dotted")
  surface_linetype <- ifelse(gene_row$surface_method == "hh_full_range", "dashed", "dotted")
  
  ggplot(df, aes(x = pseudotime, y = expr, color = condition)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = gene_row$half_height,
               linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = gene_row$cave_pseudotime_half_height,
               linetype = cave_linetype, color = "#E05A5A") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = gene_row$surface_pseudotime_half_height,
               linetype = surface_linetype, color = "#3AAFA9") +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("cave" = "#E05A5A", "surface" = "#3AAFA9")) +
    labs(x = "pseudotime", y = "expression", title = gene,
         subtitle = paste0("cave: ", gene_row$cave_method, " | surface: ", gene_row$surface_method)) +
    theme_classic()
}
plot_gene_wave("otx2a")
```
